Row4 all4 CRYSTALLINE STONE WALL: pale violet-gray rock crowns with sparse small lavender crystal facets embedded in cracks; variants1,2,3,4.
Row5 col1 CRYSTALLINE STONE WALL separate large composition, same material as row4. Col2 DARK METAL WALL variant1, col3 DARK METAL WALL variant2, col4 DARK METAL WALL large design: dark charcoal-jade worn metal obstacle top caps with broad riveted reinforced plates, slight rounded bevels and warm-gold tiny fasteners, no symbols.

Each cell complete usable top-down terrain texture, no labels, nothing transparent.
